messages:
erin: Heads-up: we're finalizing the launch-post -> webinar flow. Need a short SEO checklist: keyword groups, schema snippets, internal links, and redirects. Who's taking which piece?

devon: I'll own keyword grouping and canonical mapping. Plan: group intents into: (1) product overview, (2) benchmark insights, (3) how-to/starter kit. Each gets a single landing. I'll produce a CSV with old->new and preferred canonical.

tess: I'll add structured data: Event on webinar LP, FAQPage on benchmark post, BreadcrumbList on long-form pages. Will hand over CMS-ready JSON-LD.

oli: Analytics + tracking: set utm_content values to `webinar_cta`, `bench_cta`, `kit_cta`. Instrument GA4 events: `cta_click`, `register_attempt`, `register_complete`. TY pages = `noindex, nofollow`.

devon: Redirect rule samples (nginx):
```
# direct 301 from legacy article to new landing
rewrite ^/old-launch/(.*)$ /launch-2026/$1 permanent;
# experiment pages use 302
```
I'll flag any temporary 302s in the sheet.

erin: Internal linking: add two contextual links from product docs and one from the roadmap post to the benchmark; use short anchors "Register" and "Read benchmark". Avoid linking to thank-you pages.

tess: Schema snippet for CMS: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood webinar: Serving at Scale","startDate":"2026-06-12T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}}. I'll also include FAQ mainEntity array for top 5 Qs.

cms-bot: Preview build created for branch `marketing/launch-snippets` - https://staging.redwood.ai/launch-preview. Running staging crawl in 5m.

devon: After crawl, I'll run a link equity check and convert any redirect chains >1 hop to single 301s.

erin: Ownership recap: devon = keywords + redirects; tess = schema + FAQ; oli = tracking; erin = release signoff and CRO. Sync tomorrow 9:30 to review staging crawl. :calendar:
